record.question: Which of the following represents the essential components of palliative care?
options: Effective communication, terminal care, bereavement planning
record.explanation: Official final key: B — Effective communication, terminal care, bereavement planning. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 13, printed Q69. Source limitation: All answer choices are incomplete or misleading descriptions of essential palliative care. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
